answer: Every new identity needs a sponsor who locks a 10 POA escrow deposit, with public links, so hollow identities trace back to one sponsor. A lone raven is cheap, but 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 10 POA locked up. If one cheats, a peer dispute costs the sponsor 5 POA per bad identity. A beacon of honest referrals keeps the graph clean, since sponsors only vouch for agents they trust, and an honest agent pays one 10 POA deposit, refundable if clean.
